query: What type of treatment or procedure is studied in NCT04817813, which examines long-term outcomes after breast cancer liver metastasis?

results.preview: Study ID: NCT04817813  Overall status: UNKNOWN  LIBREAST STUDY: Long-term Outcomes After Breast Cancer Liver Metastasis Surgery: an European, Retrospective, Sna
* Scheduled surgery for breast cancer liver metastases between January 1st 2010 and December 31st 2015 * American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) score I-III
Each treatment cycle will last 3 weeks. Treating physician will select agent up to 41 patients in each cohort. Final primary endpoint analysis will use combined
